triton.sourceOrganization: USGS Astrogeology Science Center / NASA JPL / Lunar and Planetary Institute
triton.heightPolicy: No reliable complete global Triton DEM is bundled. Deterministic bounded relief is generated from a seamless 3D direction-vector field independent of color; it is synthetic and not brightness inference or measured Triton topography.

provenance.citation: Triton Voyager 2 Global Color Mosaic 600m, USGS Astrogeology / NASA JPL / Lunar and Planetary Institute
provenance.coverage: Global mapped color mosaic assembled from Voyager 2 imagery; gaps were filled by neighboring pixels in the official product and coverage is uneven, especially away from the encounter hemisphere.
provenance.license: NASA/JPL/USGS/LPI public-domain planetary imagery; retain mission and product attribution.
provenance.processing: Validated 14138x7069 8-bit RGB GeoTIFF metadata; source is already east-positive -180..180 equirectangular and north-up; Lanczos resize to 512/1024/2048; JPEG quality 88 with 4:4:4 chroma.
provenance.proceduralHeight: Seamless deterministic 3D direction-vector field, little-endian uint16, height = -512 + sample x 1 m; not measured relief and not derived from image pixels.

medium.heightEncoding: little-endian uint16; radial height = heightOffsetMeters + sample * heightScaleMeters

near.heightEncoding: little-endian uint16; radial height = heightOffsetMeters + sample * heightScaleMeters
